snippet.title: Gangs of Asia - Official Announcement Trailer | Coming May 5 on Steam
snippet.description:
Gangs of Asia launches May 5 on Steam! 🥋⚔️

A chaotic fusion of skill-based melee combat and real-time strategy. Take direct control of your gang leader, capture territory, deploy units, and dominate the streets across vibrant city districts inspired by East Asian culture. Outfight and outthink -every match is fast, unpredictable, and packed with depth.

Wishlist now and prepare to take the streets 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2382670/Gangs_Of_Asia/

#GangsOfAsia #MicroProse #ComingSoon #RTS #IndieGame #Steam"
